run_extract_pointcloud: run the script to extract point clouds from RGB-D zip archives and save PLY and NPY files
run_pc2obj: run pc2obj to export a numpy point cloud array to an OBJ file with vertex coordinates
review_pc2obj: review the pc2obj function that writes point cloud vertices to an OBJ file format
refactor_extract_pointcloud: refactor the script to replace os.system calls with Python-native file listing and glob patterns
summarize_extract_pointcloud: summarize the script that reconstructs point clouds from paired RGB and depth images using Open3D
